# Forum Fortress anti-spam add-on for XenForo

Forum Fortress helps XenForo 2.3 admins catch spam registrations, posts and
profile changes. The add-on uses the hosted Forum Fortress service and gives
admins protection settings, moderation tools and a connection test.

## Download and install

Get the current ZIP from the [XenForo add-on page](https://forumfortress.com/platforms/xenforo/).
Follow the [XenForo installation guide](https://forumfortress.com/docs/install/xenforo/)
for installation, upgrades and configuration through XenForo Admin.

The add-on is licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later. The hosted service is separate.
For help, [contact Forum Fortress](https://forumfortress.com/support/#contact).
